headline: Approved updates to the Commission's Rules of Procedure and voted to ask the City Solicitor about fee and sign rules.
summary: The Commission heard a citizen presentation on proposed changes to the City's demolition delay ordinance and agreed to review the ideas further at a future meeting. It approved administrative updates to its own Rules of Procedure and voted to ask the City Solicitor whether a fee schedule and on-site sign requirement need an ordinance change. The Commission tabled discussion of proposed state bills HD.4331 and S.1428, a consultation letter to the MHC about the Beverly Housing Rehabilitation program, and approval of the February 25 and March 12, 2026 minutes.
decisions: Approved the proposed amendments to the Rules of Procedure, as edited and discussed, 5-0.
Voted to ask the City Solicitor for an opinion on whether a fee schedule and a physical sign requirement for historic applications need an ordinance change, 5-0.
Tabled discussion on proposed Bills HD.4331 and S.1428 to a later date.
Tabled discussion on the consultation letter to MHC regarding the Beverly Housing Rehabilitation program to a later date.
Tabled approval of the February 25, 2026 and March 12, 2026 minutes to a later date.
